title: Derivation of the quantum dilogarithm volume from the topological mass formula
html:
Derivation from the topological mass formula

The topological mass formula (topological mass) gives the mass of a knot K as \mathfrak{m}(K) = \text{Vol}(K) / \hbar_q^2. For a multi-component link \mathcal{N}(Z, N), the "volume" is not the hyperbolic volume of a single knot complement, because the multi-nucleon link is not hyperbolic. Instead, the topological mass proof (topological mass proof) shows that each transient trace contribution evaluates to the quantum dilogarithm \Phi_q(z_i) on the exceptional divisor E_i (quantum dilogarithm). Summing over all exceptional divisors (one per nucleon crossing) yields the total quantum dilogarithm volume \Phi_q.

The identification \Phi_q = \sum \log |\hat{V}_i| connects the cosimplicial structure of Ch3 (the Yekutieli triples and crossed groupoid) to the Iwahori–Hecke algebra computation of Ch5 (the generator volumes).
